name: Laplacian Quadratic Form Obfuscation
description: Replaces the edge-wise product constraint with a global sum equivalent to the Laplacian quadratic form of the graph. By defining node potentials (degree * s_i^2) and edge potentials (2 * s_u * s_v) and requiring their difference to equal m, the problem implicitly requires \sum (s_u - s_v)^2 = m. Since s_i in {1, 2}, this forces every edge to have s_u != s_v, preserving the exact bipartiteness condition while hiding it behind a physics-like energy minimization framing.
